tokens.name: surface-desktop
tokens.usage: The desk behind every window: page background, always with the grid-line grid.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: 1px grid lines on surface-desktop, 24px pitch (space-6). Never on window surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Window and dialog sheets, speech bubbles. The default ground for ink text.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Wells inside a window: text inputs, progress and slider tracks, checkboxes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Face of a cream (neutral) button.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, outlines' text partner. On surface-window, surface-inset, surface-raised, surface-desktop.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, footers, disabled labels. On surface-window and surface-inset.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 2px pixel outline: windows, wells, buttons, badges, title-bar dividers. Holds 3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: bevel-light
tokens.usage: 2px highlight along a button's top edge on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Colour of hard offset shadows (shadow-pixel).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 4px, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: candy-teal
tokens.usage: Default title bar, info dialog, search icon block, 'me' speech bubble. Text on it: on-candy.

tokens.name: candy-orange
tokens.usage: Error / attention title bars, alert dialogs, secondary call-to-action buttons.

tokens.name: candy-pink
tokens.usage: Playful accents: favourites, notification dots, pink buttons and slider fills.

tokens.name: candy-lavender
tokens.usage: Navigation buttons (Back, Menu), lavender title bars.

tokens.name: candy-green
tokens.usage: Go / confirm buttons (Play, Continue, OK), checked checkboxes, success dialog.

tokens.name: candy-yellow
tokens.usage: Warnings, badges, slider fills, highlights.

tokens.name: candy-blue
tokens.usage: Loading and progress fills.

tokens.name: on-candy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any candy-* fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: lip-cream
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of a cream button.

tokens.name: lip-teal
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of a teal button.

tokens.name: lip-orange
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of an orange button.

tokens.name: lip-pink
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of a pink button.

tokens.name: lip-lavender
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of a lavender button.

tokens.name: lip-green
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of a green button.

tokens.name: deep-teal
tokens.usage: Label text on a candy-teal button.

tokens.name: deep-orange
tokens.usage: Label text on a candy-orange button.

tokens.name: deep-pink
tokens.usage: Label text on a candy-pink button.

tokens.name: deep-lavender
tokens.usage: Label text on a candy-lavender button.

tokens.name: deep-green
tokens.usage: Label text on a candy-green button.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button face, error field outline.

tokens.name: lip-danger
tokens.usage: 4px bottom lip of a danger button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label text on a danger button.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error message text on surface-window and surface-inset. Always paired with the warning icon.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Splash and title screens. One per view.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badges, bubble names, always uppercase.

styles.name: system
styles.usage: Window titles, input text (15px), status lines, numbers and timers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight padding. The base pixel step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, field gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window body padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop grid pitch; gaps between windows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large-button padding, section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Corners are square; buttons fake rounding with notched pixel corners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only round slider knobs and notification dots.

tokens.name: border-pixel
tokens.usage: One art pixel. Every outline, divider and focus ring width.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Button bottom lip depth.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow for dialogs and anything floating above the desk. Never blurred.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel-sm
tokens.usage: Small lifted elements: toasts, dragged icons.
